entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There are still people in trouble[n]out there, huh?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...That could mean there are still[n]some targets left in Mementos.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Whether there are or not, we'd better[n]be prepared for anything—who knows[n]what might happen.
